title: Session Self Service
demo: Demo mode: the data shown is sample data, not real sessions.
noLive: You have no active or disconnected sessions.
confirmOne: Log off "{name}" on {machine}? Unsaved work in this session will be lost.
confirmDisconnected: Log off all disconnected sessions? Unsaved work in them will be lost.
confirmAll: Log off ALL your sessions? Unsaved work in them will be lost.
partial: {n} session(s) logged off, {m} could not be logged off.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
hdSearchLabel: Find a user (part of the name)
hdTruncated: Only the first sessions are shown. Use the search to narrow it down.
detailsNone: No details available for this session.
chartNoData: No measurements over time for this session (they may not be collected yet or already removed).
hintClientRtt: High latency: check Wi-Fi, VPN or the distance to the datacenter.
hintClientBw: Low bandwidth: check network load, Wi-Fi signal or VPN.
hintBackendLogon: Slow logon: profile, scripts or policies may be slow. Tell the helpdesk if it stays this way.
hintBackendLoad: The server is busy. Tell the helpdesk if it stays this way.
hdMessageTitle: Send a message to the session
hdMessagePlaceholder: Text shown to the user (max. 300 characters)
procOnlyWindows: Only applications (hide Windows and Citrix system processes)
procConfirmKill: End {name} immediately? Unsaved work is lost.
procProtected: {name} is needed for the session and cannot be ended here.
procGone: {name} is already gone or does not belong to this session.
procUnavailable: The machine of the session cannot be reached for process control. Is the endpoint set up on this VDA (Install-SssJea.ps1) and WinRM (port 5985) open?
waterfallSlowest: Longest step: {name}, {s} s ({p} % of the logon).
waterfallEstimated: Dashed bars: the length is known, the position on the time axis is estimated.
profileHint: Read on the machine of the session; a large profile is a common reason for long logons.
profileScanning: Reading from the VDA, this can take a few seconds …
profileTemporary: temporary profile: the user is not working in their own profile
profileUnavailable: The profile could not be read. Is the endpoint on the VDA up to date? Run Install-SssJea.ps1 there again.
hint_tempProfile: The user got a temporary profile and is not working in their own profile. Changes are lost at logoff. Check the profile service, the container share and the user's rights.
hint_corrupted: Windows marks the profile as corrupted.
hint_containerFull: The profile container is {pct} % full ({used} of {max}). When it is full, applications fail. Increase the container size or exclude caches.
hint_containerBloated: The container takes {container} but the profile folder holds only {folder}. A VHD(X) does not shrink by itself; compact it outside of the session (for example Invoke-FslShrinkDisk).
hint_cacheOutlook: Outlook data takes {size} ({share} % of the profile) in {path}. Use an Office container (ODFC) or shorten the cached mail window.
hint_cacheTeams: Teams data takes {size} ({share} %) in {path}. Exclude the Teams cache folders from the profile.
hint_cacheBrowser: Browser data takes {size} ({share} %) in {path}. Exclude the cache folders from the profile.
hint_cacheTemp: Temporary files take {size} ({share} %) in {path}. Clean them at logoff.
hint_cacheOneDrive: OneDrive holds {size} ({share} %) in {path}. Use Files On-Demand and keep the sync folder out of the profile container.
hint_userDataLocal: {path} holds {size} and is not redirected. Large personal data in the profile slows logon; consider folder redirection or OneDrive known folder move.
hint_appdataDominates: AppData takes {size} ({share} % of the profile). The largest folders below are usually caches that can be excluded.
hint_roamingLarge: A Windows roaming profile of {size} is copied at every logon and logoff. Consider FSLogix or Citrix Profile Management with exclusions and folder redirection.
hint_roamingNoRedirection: No folders are redirected for this roaming profile. Redirect Documents, Desktop and Downloads to keep it small.
hint_upmNoStreaming: Profile streaming is off in Citrix Profile Management. With streaming, large profiles load faster because files are fetched when needed.
hint_upmNoExclusions: No exclusion lists are configured in Citrix Profile Management but the profile is {size}. Exclude caches and temporary folders.
hint_fslogixNoExclusions: No redirections.xml exclusions were found for this {size} FSLogix profile. Excluding caches (Teams, browsers, Temp) keeps the container small.
hint_manyLocalProfiles: {count} local profiles exist on this machine. Delete profiles at logoff (cleanup policy) to save disk space and logon time.
hint_scanPartial: The folder scan stopped after {seconds} s. All sizes are lower bounds.
hint_profileLoadSlow: Loading the profile took {s} s ({p} % of the logon). Compare it with the size and type above.
waterfallAt: starts {s} s after the logon began
